core_meaning.primary_meaning: Fiza is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Open expanse, spaciousness”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Fiza corresponds to the Arabic form فِضا (Arabic root ف ض و (f-ḍ-w) / ف ي ض (f-y-ḍ)). Its core sense is liberated, free, independent. Fiza is a popular South Asian female name. Its usual form فِضا relates to Arabic فضى 'open expanse, spaciousness' (hence 'openness, freedom'), though it is also popularly associated with a different Persianate word for breeze/atmosphere. The source gloss 'blooming, radiant' is unsupported and has not been carried over; the source also gave فيضة as the Arabic form, which belongs to Feyza, not Fiza.
